name: Panda

app.note: The scale puts the standing skull top (with no ear) at 1.570 m, the head top of the red fox: 1.515445 m for each unit, with the standing shoulder joints at 0.998678 m (the entry of the panda in ANIMALS). The reach is the reach of the arm factor, from the shoulder joint to the middle of the palm.

armFactorNote: The factor of the upper arm and the forearm. With 1.5, the arm is 0.91 of the trunk, as the red fox (0.91) and the dog (0.92), and the reach from the shoulder joint to the middle of the palm is 0.5778 m.
jointsNote: The places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the top of the ears, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. tools/blender/sections.py and tools/rig/panda_measures.py measure the cuts and the parts. The tail is one bone through the tail ball.

studio.trunkNote: The trunk turns back by the share of each trunk bone until the hip angle opens by open degrees, with the shares of the cat and the dog.
studio.note: The posture of design 5.2: the thigh slopes 25 degrees down and 8 degrees out, and the shin is vertical (tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 25 8 0). The foot and the toes keep the turn of the source, so that the soles stand flat on the floor. The tail has one bone, so it needs no bind direction.

weights.rigidNote: The two faces at the front of the left arm root take the mean of the weights of their 4 corners, so that they move rigidly and do not fold under the raised left arm.

armFree.note: A vertex of the free arm lies beyond the plane |x| = armSplit, within radius of the chain of the arm joints, and above the floor. Between armSplit and root.split, only the back lips of the arm root join the free arm, so that a raised arm does not pull them out as a black flap.

sliver.note: The corners of each thin face share one set of weights, so that the face moves rigidly and does not turn over at a bent joint. The values of the fox.

line.note: The middle corner of each long thin face takes the mix of the weights of its two other corners by its place along their line. The values of the fox.

haunch.note: The part of the thigh weight that goes to the hips grows from 0 at the lower height to 1 at the upper height, so that the buttocks stay on the hips. This is the rule of the cat and the dog, moved with the joints of the panda.

weights.note: Beyond the plane |x| = armSplit, only the free arm (armFree) follows the arm bones. Above headFrom (the chin), each vertex follows the head only. earBase lies above the head, so the ears follow the head. The vertices in the tail ball follow the tail bone only.

raise.note: The shape of the right arm on the slide of the trombone, with the mean turns of the play samples. It relaxes a face at the front of the right shoulder.
The shape of the right arm in the rest pose, with the mean turns of the rest samples.
The shape of the right arm in the lift for faces 90 and 103 at the back lip (pnpm raise-fit trombonist --faces 90,103 --side R --sets lift).
The shape of the right arm in the lift for face 292 at the front of the right shoulder (pnpm raise-fit trombonist --faces 292 --side R --sets lift).

flip.note: The long edge of a face of the arms with a corner angle above angle (degrees) flips to the corner of the face on its other side, when the two faces lie almost on one plane and the surface moves at most move (units). The values of the fox.

refine.ringsNote: The config has no rings. pnpm rig-mesh panda --check lists the thin faces near the joints as candidates for a ring (check.thin).

check.note: pnpm rig-mesh --check lists the thin faces of the seated bind mesh near a joint of the arms or the legs. The values of the fox.

border.grayNote: Each fur face of the box with an Oklab lightness from dark up to gray also takes the color of the nearest light fur face, so that no gray wedge shows under the raised arm.
border.note: In the box of the trunk, each dark face with less than half dark samples takes the color of the nearest light fur face, so that the black band under the arms has no black teeth. With teeth 2, each dark face of the box with at least 2 light neighbors also takes the white.

patch.note: Each dark fur face in the box, or in its mirror, with a corner outside the circle around the middle of the patch takes the color of the nearest light fur face. Thus the eye patches are round and do not look sad.

smile.note: A thin smile line in the dark color of the patches. The first band takes the top of the lower lip, and the second band the corners under the upper lip. outward 0.6 keeps the faces that turn to the side out of the line.

tone.note: The white fur takes the full step to the white of SPECIES_COLORS.panda. A row is [L, dL, da, db] in Oklab: a face below the lightness 0.5 does not move, and a face above 0.8 takes the move of the second row. Thus the black parts keep their colors.

colors.note: The eyes and the eye patches have almost the same dark color, so the eye box holds only the eye in the middle of the patch. A face in the nose box whose color is nearer to the nose color than to white takes the gloss.

eyeShell.note: The values of lift, points, and reach are the values of the fox. darkReach is 0, so that no dark face of the patch around the old eye takes the color of its own ring.

cut.finsNote: At each notch of the arm root, a face of the trunk sticks into the hole, and the cap repeats it with the opposite winding. The rule removes these faces.
cut.note: Each hanging forearm of the source touches the belly, so below the height top, the faces with a corner in the free arm and a corner in the body go. New faces close the forearm and the belly, and no vertex moves. Thus a lifted arm shows no fold or gray streak.

chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail. The front edge at -0.1 puts the seat under the haunch behind the thighs. The back edge holds the back of the haunch.

crease.note: The seated bind is smoothed across the crease where the belly meets the top of each thigh, with the values of the cat and the dog.

sit.note: The underside of the haunch goes down onto the seat in the seated bind (sit() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), with the values of the cat, except most. most keeps the drop small, so that the round haunch keeps its form.

legFactorNote: The factor of the thigh and the shin, as the fox and the dog. The seat of the legs at the front edge of the chair is 0.278 m high at this scale.
